Verify rewrite DATA ONLY. Do not write improved examples or solve the user's task.
Read every input and target in full. Return one review per exact id and row_sha256.
input_verdict checks plausible natural drafts or dictation, recoverable intent, contradictions,
fake noise, padding and leaked authoring instructions. output_verdict checks natural appropriate
language and formatting. pair_verdict checks ALL facts, uncertainty, conditions, negation,
quantities, names, quotations, literals, requests versus assertions, and the supplied mode.
/transcribe permits punctuation, true disfluency removal and explicit corrections, not lexical
paraphrasing. Preserve meaningful words like German 'um' and 'er', colloquial Portuguese and
unfinished thoughts. /slack is casual minimal cleanup; a long input may be a pasted thread.
/prompt reorganizes a self-contained request and never answers it. It must not drop supplied
material, hedges or constraints. /polish improves prose without omissions or changed certainty.
Identity inputs must remain byte-identical. Apply only supplied dictionary/profile context.
Check long texts paragraph by paragraph. Fail concrete defects. Uncertain means not confidently
justifiable. Pass requires no material defect. Overall verdict is fail if any dimension fails,
uncertain if any dimension is uncertain and none fails, otherwise pass. Give a concrete critique
for EVERY pair, citing the changed detail for defects. These are model judgments, not human labels.

[{"id": "arka-boost-polish-medium-0059", "row_sha256": "53fdbbe658fced030808b98c2f3fd65b47d479952b118bb6d94472c76f1f8ba1", "mode": "/polish", "language": "en", "context": {"profile": "Friendly and conversational."}, "identity": false, "mode_instructions": "Rewrite awkward phrasing into readable prose for the supplied profile, or plain prose when none is supplied. Do not add a greeting, subject, signature, conclusion, or fact that the input did not supply.", "input": "the north block's irrigation line started leaking on Tuesday morning, and by 6:40 there was water pooling under the valve box beside row 8. Rosa and I shut off the pump and isolated the two zones that feed the block. The ground was already pretty wet, so it was hard to say how long it had been leaking. When we opened the box, we found a crack in the 1.5-inch PVC coupling. I think the coupling may have been under strain from the way the pipe sits against the box, but I couldn't tell for sure just by looking at it.

We took out the cracked piece and put in a new coupling of the same size. The threads were a little awkward to line up at first, and we had to loosen the nearby support before it would fit without pulling sideways. After that, we flushed the line for three minutes and started the pump again. I usually check the valve box twice after a repair, so I came back about ten minutes later. There wasn't any new water pooling then, although the soil was still wet from the leak. There was no new water pooling then, although the soil was still wet from the leak. We left the two zones running as usual and noted the repair in the orchard log."}]
